cards.text: Elisha is a prophet in Israel (2 Kings 5:8), and he meets with a group called the sons of the prophets. One day they ask Elisha to let them go down to the Jordan and build. But first, they tell him about a problem with the place where they meet with him now.

cards.question: The sons of the prophets want to build a new place by the Jordan. What's the problem with the place where they meet with Elisha now?

cards.text: Here's the plan: each of them gets a log at the Jordan, and they build themselves a place to live there. Me? I'd show up dragging a twig with my mustache, yelling that I BROUGHT MY PART.

cards.question: Elisha tells the sons of the prophets to go ahead with their plan to build by the Jordan.

cards.text: They're about to head out. But I think one of them doesn't want to go down to the Jordan without Elisha.

cards.question: Before they head out, one of the sons of the prophets asks Elisha for one more thing. What is it?
One of the sons of the prophets asks Elisha to come with them, and Elisha turns him down.

cards.text: “I will come,” Elisha says, and when they reach the Jordan, they start cutting down trees. That's asking your boss to help you move, and he actually says YES.
Everybody's chopping. Then one man swings at a tree, and the iron axe head comes right off the handle.

cards.question: The man is cutting trees beside the Jordan when the iron axe head comes off, and it falls into the water.
The man cries out to Elisha about the lost iron axe head. What makes it even worse is that it was ___.

cards.text: Borrowed. That's borrowing your buddy's car and calling him from the side of the road like, “Sooo… about your car.” Then Elisha, the man of God, asks the man one question.

cards.question: The man just lost a borrowed axe head in the Jordan. What's the one question Elisha asks him?

answers.text: Who did you borrow it from
How did it slip off the handle

cards.text: The man shows Elisha the spot. Me? I'd have dived in face-first and sunk straight to the bottom, gold base and all.

cards.question: Elisha doesn't go into the water after the axe head. Right there among the trees, he cuts a ___ and throws it where the axe head fell.
Elisha throws the stick in right where the iron axe head went down. What happens next?

cards.text: The iron is floating on the Jordan. “Lift it out,” Elisha tells the man.

cards.question: When Elisha tells him to lift it out, the man reaches out his hand and takes the floating axe head.

cards.text: IRON. FLOATING. Friend, I spent YEARS in the back of a junk drawer waiting for somebody to pull me out, and this axe head gets out of a RIVER just like that.
